summary: Backend testing for Phase 1 features: PATCH exercise category/order endpoints, GET today planId field, POST switch-mode endpoints. All 12 tests pass.

minor.issue: Imported plans (user_a) have empty sessionExerciseId ('') on exercises — these endpoints will always return 404 for imported plans that haven't been through plan_extractor.py. Only AI-generated plans (user_b) work correctly.
move_exercise_up returns updatedSessions=0 when exercise is already first (expected, but worth noting — no feedback to caller about 'already at top')

action_items: Add a backfill migration to assign sessionExerciseId (via uuid) to exercises in imported plans that currently have empty sessionExerciseId — without this, the kebab menu category/order endpoints will 404 for user_a's imported plan
Consider returning updatedSessions=0 with a user-friendly message when exercise is already at top/bottom for order endpoint
critical_code_review_comments: server.py line 107 (old bug now fixed in test): the session_context fixture was using token_a instead of token_b — test issue, not production code
The two new PATCH endpoints (category + order) correctly apply changes to current+future sessions and invalidate the in-memory plan cache — implementation looks correct
switch-mode free: correctly archives plans (not deletes) and sets training_mode; switch-mode program: correctly sets training_mode and returns needsPathChoice=True — both work as expected
seed_data_creation: Restored user_b's archived plan to active status in MongoDB (plan was accidentally archived by earlier test run)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 1 backend endpoints all working. Key finding: imported plans (user_a) have empty sessionExerciseId on exercises making category/order PATCH endpoints unusable for them. AI-generated plans (user_b) work correctly. A backfill migration is needed.
rca_of_issue: imported plan exercises have sessionExerciseId='' because plan_extractor.py assigns IDs during extraction but user_a's plan (Westside Strongman Modified) appears to have been imported/seeded before this field was reliably populated. The PATCH endpoints search by ex.sessionExerciseId == exercise_id so empty string never matches.
